findings.message: The customer value is interpolated into a raw SQL string passed to `FromSqlRaw`, so a crafted customer name can inject arbitrary SQL. This also breaks the repository rule that raw SQL goes only through `FromSql` with interpolated parameters.
findings.suggestion: return db.Orders.FromSql($"SELECT * FROM Orders WHERE Customer = {customer}").ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
